title: 第19章 损友们第20章 有只小偷
lines: 第19章损友们
第二天早上，邹玲洗漱之后，跟着周凯进了厨房，虽说已经经历过到处放着古董的客厅的洗礼，进了厨房，还是有几分目瞪口呆。
她见过的豪宅不少，可厨房奢侈成这样的，这是头一回看到。
“邹小姐坐吧，你昨天醉的厉害，米姨给你熬了点儿白粥。”盛夏刚刚进来，招手示意邹玲。
“我不喝白粥，还有别的吗？”周凯几步窜到米丽身边，伸头四下看。
“生滚鱼片粥。”米丽随口答了句，她只准备盛夏想吃的。
“这个好！”周凯不用米丽和盛夏招呼，自己拿了碗，盛了碗生滚鱼片粥，尝了一口，啧啧有声，“鲜，香，这米真香，你也尝尝？”
周凯看着伸头看过来的邹玲，一边一口接一口吃粥，一边让邹玲。
邹玲犹豫了下，摇头，她不吃鱼，太腥气。
米丽从蒸笼里取出韭菜鸡蛋蒸饺，另一只锅里的蟹粉生煎也好了，米丽掀开锅盖，撒了把黑芝麻，又撒了把香葱，将底面焦黄酥脆的生煎盛出来，放到餐桌上。
邹玲瞪着桌子上还在滋滋作响的铜钱大小的香煎野菜饼，刚刚出笼，鲜香诱人的韭菜蒸饺，和米丽刚刚送上来的生煎，以及旁边一碟生菜碧绿，漂亮诱人的小小的三明治，简直不敢相信，“这都是现做的？早上起来做的？这太浪费时间了吧！”
周凯呛着了，米丽好象没听到邹玲的话，盛夏伸筷子挟了只生煎过来，示意邹玲，“邹小姐尝尝，比外面卖的强。”
邹玲的筷子在韭菜蒸饺和野菜饼之间犹豫了下，挟了只蒸饺，一口咬下去，就顾不上别的了，几口吃完，又挟了一只，中间喝了一口薄薄的白米粥，就吃一口蒸饺喝一口白粥，一口气吃了四五个蒸饺，喝光了一碗粥。
“真好吃，谢谢你。”邹玲已经饱了，可看着蒸饺，还想再吃一两个，这么好吃的韭菜饺，她好象就很小的时候吃过一回。
“邹小姐要是喜欢吃，以后常来。”盛夏已经吃好了，站起来，“要喝杯咖啡吗？”
“别吃了，你看看，一盘子快让你吃光了，吃撑了不舒服。”周凯下巴冲着蒸饺碟子努了努，一脸的我都是为了你好。
邹玲斜了他一眼，没理他，只看着盛夏道：“我想要一杯，浓一点。”
盛夏打开冰箱，拿了咖啡壶出来，放到桌上，米丽站起来，拿了温热的牛奶和粉，和几只咖啡杯过来。
“冰滴？我也要一杯，静置多长时间了？”周凯眼睛亮了。
“现在喝正正好。”盛夏接了句。
邹玲倒了大半杯，没放牛奶也没放，抿了一口，品了片刻，满足的叹了口气，“太香了。”
周凯也倒了杯咖啡，再倒了一勺半牛奶进去，眯眼品起来。
“你得回去换换衣服吧？你不是还要见什么会计师事务所的人？”周凯喝好咖啡，抬起手表给邹玲看，以示时间不早了、
“这是你家？”邹玲突然想起来什么，看看米丽，又看看盛夏。
“不是。”周凯和米丽异口同声。
“是我们家，不是他家，知道他为什么把你带到了我们家么？”盛夏指指米丽，笑眯眯道。

Chapter 19 Harming Friends
The next morning, after Zou Ling washed up, she followed Zhou Kai into the kitchen. Although she had already experienced the baptism of the living room with antiques everywhere, she was still a little stunned when she entered the kitchen.
She has seen many luxury houses, but this is the first time she has seen such a luxurious kitchen.
"Miss Zou, sit down. You were very drunk yesterday. Aunt Mi made you some porridge." Shengxia just came in and waved to Zou Ling.
"I don't drink porridge, is there anything else?" Zhou Kai rushed to Mi Li's side in a few steps and stretched his head to look around.
"Porridge with raw fish slices." Mili replied casually. She only prepared what she wanted to eat in midsummer.
"This is good!" Zhou Kai didn't need to greet Mi Li and Sheng Xia. He took a bowl and filled it with raw fish fillet porridge. He took a bite and clicked his tongue, "It's fresh and fragrant. This rice is so fragrant. Do you want to try it too?"
Zhou Kai looked at Zou Ling who was looking over, eating porridge one after another while letting Zou Ling.
Zou Ling hesitated and shook her head. She didn't eat fish, it was too fishy.
Mi Li took out the leek and egg steamed dumplings from the steamer, and the pan-fried crab meat in the other pot was ready. Mi Li opened the lid, sprinkled a handful of black sesame seeds, and a handful of chives, took out the pan-fried pan-fried dumplings that were browned and crispy on the bottom, and put them on the dining table.
Zou Ling stared at the pan-fried wild vegetable pancakes the size of copper coins that were still sizzling on the table. They had just come out of the cage, the fragrant steamed chive dumplings, the pan-fried pancakes that Mili had just served, and the beautiful and attractive little sandwiches with green lettuce next to them. She couldn't believe it, "These are all freshly made? Did you make them in the morning? This is such a waste of time!"
Zhou Kai choked, and Mi Li didn't seem to hear Zou Ling's words. Shengxia stretched out her chopsticks and brought a piece of fried food over to Zou Ling, "Miss Zou, try it. It's better than what's sold outside."
Zou Ling's chopsticks hesitated between steamed leek dumplings and wild vegetable pancakes. She picked up one steamed dumpling and bit into it without caring about anything else. After finishing a few bites, she picked up another one. She took a sip of thin white rice porridge, then took a mouthful of steamed dumplings and a sip of white porridge. She ate four or five steamed dumplings in one go and finished the bowl of porridge.
"It's delicious, thank you." Zou Ling was already full, but looking at the steamed dumplings, she wanted to eat one or two more. She seemed to have eaten such delicious leek dumplings once when she was very young.
"If Miss Zou likes to eat, come here often." Shengxia had already finished eating and stood up, "Would you like a cup of coffee?"
"Stop eating. Look, you've almost finished the entire plate. It's uncomfortable to overeat." Zhou Kai pressed his chin against the steamed dumpling plate with a look on his face that said, "I'm doing this all for your own good."
Zou Ling glanced at him sideways, ignored him, just looked at Shengxia and said, "I want a cup, a little stronger."
Shengxia opened the refrigerator, took out the coffee pot, and put it on the table. Millie stood up, brought warm milk and powder, and a few coffee cups.
"Ice drops? I want a cup too. How long has it been sitting for?" Zhou Kai's eyes lit up.
"It's a good time to drink now." Shengxia continued.
Zou Ling poured half of the cup without adding milk, took a sip, tasted it for a moment, and sighed with satisfaction, "It's so fragrant."
Zhou Kai also poured a cup of coffee, poured a spoonful and a half of milk into it, and squinted to taste it.
"You have to go back and change your clothes, right? Don't you want to meet someone from the accounting firm?" Zhou Kai drank the coffee and raised his watch to show Zou Ling to show that it was getting late.
"This is your home?" Zou Ling suddenly remembered something and looked at Mili and then at Shengxia.
"No." Zhou Kai and Mi Li said in unison.
"It's our home, not his home. Do you know why he brought you to our home?" Shengxia pointed at Mili and said with a smile.
